outcomes.statement: Group Admins have accurate, replayable person-day activity from API-enabled vendor accounts, using the same identity matching and idempotent persistence boundary available to CSV/manual ingestion.

outcomes.statement: Group Admins have exact person-day costs that incorporate vendor revisions within the 30-day window without overwriting older costs.

uncertainties.statement: Canonical prerequisites are complete; no readiness approval or execution evidence exists for US-026.
uncertainties.resolution: Parsed .nous-feedback.jsonl has terminal done events for US-018, US-046, US-056, US-057 and US-058 and no US-026 execution events at b6b651d. SPRINT_PLAN adds US-018 to the story-file prerequisite set. Neither US-055 nor US-029 is a prerequisite; this delivery supplies shared persistence/freshness semantics and does not implement their UI. Recheck terminal projections if prerequisite evidence is superseded.

uncertainties.statement: Existing activity connector uses organization totals as every user's counters, and silently removes null-email identities.
uncertainties.resolution: packages/connectors/src/providers/anthropic/connector.ts syncActivity parses analytics users only as user_id/email, then duplicates one summary's active_users/conversations into every record. Official documentation inspected 2026-10-05 at https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/beta/organization/analytics/users/list describes per-user chat_metrics, claude_code_metrics and cowork_metrics. Correct the contract/parser to retain per-user metrics and unmatched identity evidence; update existing Pact fixtures and connector tests. Preserve existing credential separation, paging bounds, rate limiter and observation bridge. The US-054 probe contains documentation/synthetic evidence, not real tenant payloads. A provider schema incompatibility or additional required beta policy discovered during contract work triggers reassessment; fixtures alone do not prove provider compatibility.

uncertainties.statement: Allowlisted replay payload policy is approved and canonically reconciled.
uncertainties.resolution: Francisco approved allowlisted per-record replay payloads in this conversation on 2026-10-05. CHG-068, delivered at smp 1ac81e1 (Nous 10cd1fcd), reconciles DEC-SMP-024 into US-026 AC1, the two child stories and ActivityRecord/CostRecord ER descriptions. Retain metrics, dates, provenance and necessary replay identity fields; exclude headers, credentials and unrelated user data. The estimate excludes encrypted original-response storage.

uncertainties.statement: Human approved manual backfill for unconfigured accounts and explicit API opt-in.
uncertainties.resolution: Francisco approved in this conversation on 2026-10-05: backfill unconfigured VendorAccounts to manual ingestion and enable api explicitly per account. Implement DEC-SMP-018 ingestion_mode/source fields with append-only migrations and source-aware shared persistence. Provisioning automated/orchestration remains independent. No configuration UI, CSV parsing or manual-entry screen is included; those remain US-055. The activity child establishes mode gating/source primitives and the cost child reuses them. Verification includes no provider calls for csv_import/manual accounts and preserves existing provisioning mode. CHG-068 delivers DEC-SMP-025 and the canonical US-070 migration ownership at 1ac81e1; US-070 owns the manual default/backfill independently of provisioning mode.

uncertainties.statement: Upserts need runtime privileges and schema parity; tenant scope is indirect through Person.
uncertainties.resolution: Committed init migration has unique(account,person,date) constraints, while Drizzle activityRecord/costRecord declarations omit them. V20260725180000 grants INSERT and revokes UPDATE/DELETE generally, without regranting telemetry UPDATE; no later telemetry grants were found. Budget append-only least-privilege upsert support and committed-migration verification under ledger_app, plus Drizzle uniqueness parity. Telemetry and VendorAccount lack company_id; person.company_id is the actual tenant column, and lower(person.email) has a unique index. Resolve identity and company through Person, keep account identity distinct from company authorization, and constrain company-facing access through the Person join. Verify shared-account cross-company isolation, foreign-account writes and case-normalized email matching with real DB fixtures. Do not invent direct company_id columns on telemetry or use VendorAccount as the tenant boundary.

uncertainties.statement: Daily scheduling exists but execution, lag-aware observation dates, replay window, warnings and exact cost persistence do not.
uncertainties.resolution: apps/worker/src/jobs/deferred.ts analyticsSync returns dependencyNotDelivered(US-026). packages/domain/src/jobs/schedule.ts supplies daily scheduling and distinct scheduled/account idempotency keys. Existing connector SyncInput accepts one observedAt date; syncCost fetches one day and discards null-email users. Budget a bounded account/day replay loop for the 30-day revision window, an explicit lag-aware activity observation policy, shared idempotent record writes, account-mode gating, retry/resource cleanup and durable job-level sync audit with unmatched-row warning counts/details available to operators. Proposed activity default is a conservative three-day lag consistent with the committed ER model, with injected UTC dates; proposed cost window is the preceding 30 completed UTC dates, oldest included. These date policies must be presented in the later design and approved. Preserve decimal strings through persistence and verify precision/rounding using property-based tests. Null identity must be counted as unmatched rather than lost or fabricated. Warnings use existing operational job/audit surfaces; a new warning screen would expand scope and requires reassessment.

uncertainties.statement: The parent exceeds readiness limits and needs canonical vertical children after its open scope decisions are resolved.
uncertainties.resolution: CHG-068 delivered official US-070 and US-071 at smp 1ac81e1 (Nous 10cd1fcd). Their canonical stories allocate parent AC1 to activity, AC2 to cost and the respective sides of AC3/AC4 to both. The 510-minute total, two primary outcomes and file/flow limits require partitioning. US-070 precedes US-071. Parent dependencies are represented by this partition graph, rather than blocked_by entries that would obscure the partition decision; canonical US-026 closes only by parent-level verification after both children dev_done. This historical scope assessment authorizes no parent implementation or closure. At parent verification, create a fresh verification-only readiness assessment and collect new digest-bound approval. Each child requires its separately approved assessment, design and plan. Proposal IDs are now official; neither this pending parent payload nor canonical delivery alone is child execution authorization.

This child proves email matching, unmatched/null-identity warnings, API-only scheduling, source provenance and synced_at semantics for activity while establishing reusable inputs. It does not satisfy cost-side behavior, which is verified by the cost child.

uncertainties.statement: Preserve exact decimal money, null-identity warnings and approved replay payloads.
uncertainties.resolution: The existing connector sums fractional-cent amounts as decimal strings but drops users without email and returns raw:null. Reuse the activity child identity/warning/payload contract for costs, retaining exact decimal strings through numeric(12,4) persistence. Define and property-test the explicit storage precision/rounding policy, negative corrections and invalid/overflow rejection during the approved design. No floating-point money arithmetic.

uncertainties.statement: Add bounded cost revisions with source-aware idempotent persistence.
uncertainties.resolution: Parent U5/U6 identify one-day SyncInput, existing DB natural-key uniqueness, absent Drizzle uniqueness/source and missing runtime UPDATE privilege. Add the cost-specific append-only migration, source/unique declarations and narrow ledger_app upsert support. Reuse delivered ingestion-mode selection, company-scoped Person identity and worker orchestration. Design specifies an injected UTC 30-day completed-date window and failure/retry behavior; verify oldest eligible versus excluded dates, repeated/concurrent runs, changed costs and foreign-account/company isolation with real DB fixtures.

partitions.cross_cutting_rationale: AC3 and AC4 require independent evidence on cost rows and cost provider calls. This child reuses the activity child matching, source and mode boundaries, and verifies unmatched identities, non-API exclusion and synced_at freshness specifically for cost revisions.
